newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU April jobless rate steady at 10.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: EU April jobless rate steady at 10.8 percent.

text.p: European Union unemployment was unchanged at 10.8 percent in April, with 18.1 million people out of work, the EU's statistical arm said Wednesday.
The results showed unemployment steady with March and little changed from April 1996, when it stood at 10.9 percent.

The EU statistical agency Eurostat said the stubbornly high rate masked a steady decline in unemployment among people under 25 years old, which fell to 20.9 percent in April from 22.0 percent a year earlier.
Among the EU's 15 nations, joblessness over the past few months continued to rise in Finland but fell in Britain, Ireland and Spain. Elsewhere there was little change, Eurostat noted.
Spain continued to have the highest level of unemployment at 20.9 percent while Luxembourg retained the lowest rate at 3.7 percent.
